description: This file is a C header file (.h) that declares functions, macros, and includes related to the nl80211 protocol for wireless device management. It contains function prototypes for sending netlink commands, handling requests synchronously and asynchronously, and adding attributes to messages. The content also includes license information and macro definitions relevant to the nl80211 API implementation.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_addNlAttrs
methods.description: Adds simple and nested netlink attributes to a netlink message, used internally to construct requests.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmd
methods.description: Sends a netlink command, either synchronously or asynchronously, with callbacks for reply handling.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSync
methods.description: Sends a synchronous netlink command and waits for the response.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends a synchronous netlink command and waits for acknowledgment.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdAsyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous netlink command and handles deferred acknowledgment.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_clearAllExpiredRequests
methods.description: Clears expired or timed-out requests from all socket managers.
